references.name: beta-Si3N4, 295 K synchrotron refinement
references.selection_basis: Experimental 295 K P63/m model from the source article; complete four-N shell at the sole inequivalent Si site. Si-C chemistry is deferred; this is a Si-N reference.
calculation_cautions: Raw CIF _cell_formula_units_Z=1.5 conflicts with the symmetry-expanded Si6N8 composition (Z=2); original bytes retained. Potentials must use actual expanded composition, not the erroneous Z metadata.
This is beta-Si3N4 with Si-N scattering; it is not a SiC or Si-C reference.
